column1: If you're going to check the airport. Keith says to you, "I'll stay here and see what I can find."
column2: 「如果你要去檢查機場，」基斯對你說，「我留在這裡看看能找到什麼。」

column1: I'll let dispatch know we've located the car, and have them send a tow truck, suggests Keith.
column2: 「我會通知派遣中心我們找到車了，請他們派拖吊車過來。」基斯建議。

column1: You seem to have lost track of Keith, somehow.
column2: 你似乎不知怎麼跟基斯走散了。

column1: You don't want to get lost in a sea of cars.
column2: 你不想迷失在車海裡。

column1: You can't seem to find any clues in this area.
column2: 你似乎在這區域找不到任何線索。

column1: Finding yourself lost in a sea of cars, you decide to make your way back...if you can!?
column2: 你發現自己迷失在車海裡，決定設法回去……如果辦得到的話！？

column1: We're about to file a missing person's report on you!
column2: 我們就要替你申報失蹤人口了！

column1: Are you having fun? Send a post card - we miss you.
column2: 玩得開心嗎？寄張明信片回來——我們想你。

column1: Enthusiastically, Keith says "Yep, Sonny! We'll get that *#!*? Bains now!"
column2: 基斯興奮地說：「沒錯，桑尼！我們現在就去抓那個 *#!*? 班恩斯！」

column1: Keith suggests, "Sonny, we'd better get going!"
column2: 基斯建議：「桑尼，我們最好出發了！」

column1: Keith says, "Well, let's do something, Sonny."
column2: 基斯說：「好吧，我們做點什麼吧，桑尼。」

column1: Keith snorts; "While you were wasting time in the airport, I located that car stolen from the shopping center."
column2: 基斯哼了一聲：「你在機場浪費時間時，我已找到購物中心遭竊的那輛車。」

column1: Continuing, Keith says..."The tow truck has already come and towed it away."
column2: 基斯接著說……「拖吊車已經來把它拖走了。」

column1: Keith must still be wandering around the parking lot looking for Bains' car.
column2: 基斯一定還在停車場裡徘徊，尋找班恩斯的車。

column1: Go on ahead, Keith says. "I'll take care of business here."
column2: 「你先走，」基斯說。「我會處理這裡的事。」

column1: While you were gone, I had dispatch send a tow truck. It's already taken the stolen car away.
column2: 「你離開時，我請派遣中心派了拖吊車。它已經把失竊車拖走了。」

column1: While you were gone, they came and towed the stolen car away, Keith informs you.
column2: 「你離開時，他們來把失竊車拖走了。」基斯告訴你。

column1: Well it's about time you got back, Keith grunts. "Let's roll!"
column2: 「你總算回來了，」基斯咕噥道。「我們走！」

column1: All the doors here are closed.
column2: 這裡所有車門都關著。

column1: You're not close enough to an open trunk.
column2: 你離開著的後車廂還不夠近。

column1: You are just outside the new Lytton Airport. The hustle and bustle makes LAX look small-time.
column2: 你就在新萊頓機場外。繁忙喧鬧的景象讓洛杉磯國際機場都相形失色。

column1: A short distance away you see the entrance to the airport.
column2: 不遠處可以看見機場入口。

column1: You see a variety of automobiles parked in the lot.
column2: 你看見停車場裡停著各式各樣的汽車。

column1: Looking around, you become alerted to the fact that you're standing in the parking lot of "Lytton Municipal Airport."
column2: 你環顧四周，意識到自己正站在「萊頓市立機場」的停車場裡。

column1: In the tower, the air traffic controllers are busy directing airline traffic.
column2: 塔台裡，航管員正忙著指揮航空交通。
